posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
I hate the Pillars of Hercules.

That is all.

Still got Mint, thanks to obscene amounts of healing by Scholar and Haka (and a last-second Retribution from Fanatic before she went down). Managed enough card draw with the latter to sustain five Forms for a couple turns -- combined with the Phosphorescent Chamber and Redeemer Fanatic's incap ability, he clobbered most of the Ennead single-handedly. The highlight and big turnaround of the game was the turn I managed to get all four Keep Movings in Hand and two "Get Out Of The Way!"s just as the deck reshuffled, putting nearly all my forms back into the deck.

If it wasn't for an ill-timed Alchemical Redirection (and my decision to get rid of Flesh to Iron), he would've finished them off, but it dropped him and left Haka to do the clean-up. He mostly did this by healing up and occasionally hitting people, but he managed to end up on top with the Mystical Defenses and Kraken finishing off Tefnut thanks to Set putting the former into play. I'm just glad I decided to KO Shu before the Scholar went down.
